speak.tip.TWO_POINTERS: I notice the input is sorted or can be sorted. I will place two pointers and move the one that improves the invariant, achieving linear time after sorting.
speak.tip.SLIDING_WINDOW: This asks for a contiguous subarray/substring with a constraint. I will expand the right bound, shrink the left when invalid, and track the best window.
speak.tip.FAST_SLOW_POINTERS: I will use a slow pointer stepping once and a fast pointer stepping twice to detect a cycle or find the middle in constant space.
speak.tip.TREE_DFS: I will recurse on the tree, defining what each call returns, handling the null base case, then combining left and right results.
speak.tip.TREE_BFS: I will process nodes level by level with a queue; the queue size at the start of each loop is the width of the current level.
speak.tip.DYNAMIC_PROGRAMMING: I will define the state, the recurrence, and base cases, then fill bottom-up to avoid recomputing overlapping subproblems.
speak.tip.GRAPHS: I will model this as a graph, choose BFS or DFS, and track visited nodes to explore connectivity or shortest paths.
speak.tip.BACKTRACKING: I will build a partial solution, prune when constraints fail, then undo the choice and try the next option.
speak.tip.INTERVALS: I will sort intervals by start, then merge or scan overlaps in a single pass while tracking the active end.
speak.tip.TOP_K_ELEMENTS: I will keep a heap of size K so each insertion stays logarithmic in K, giving an efficient top-K selection.
speak.tip.MODIFIED_BINARY_SEARCH: I will binary search on a rotated or unbounded range, deciding which half is still sorted or still feasible each step.
speak.tip.DEFAULT: I will restate the problem, identify the pattern, state time and space complexity, then walk through a small example before coding.
diagram.caption.TWO_POINTERS: L and R move toward the goal — each step discards impossible pairs.
diagram.caption.SLIDING_WINDOW: Expand right to include; shrink left when the constraint breaks.
diagram.caption.TREE_DFS: Go deep along a branch, then backtrack — preorder / inorder / postorder.
diagram.caption.TREE_BFS: Queue processes the tree level by level.
diagram.caption.FAST_SLOW_POINTERS: Fast moves 2×; if they meet, a cycle exists.
diagram.caption.INTERVALS: Sort by start, then merge when the next start overlaps the current end.
diagram.caption.TOP_K_ELEMENTS: Keep a bounded heap of size K; push/pop to retain only the best K.
diagram.caption.MODIFIED_BINARY_SEARCH: Decide which half is sorted or feasible, then discard the other half.
diagram.caption.BACKTRACKING: Try a choice, recurse, then undo and try the next option.
